headline: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in on Mac
summary: OpenAI has launched a new plug-in allowing ChatGPT to connect with your Apple Messages inbox, enabling the AI to sort, analyze, edit, draft, and send messages on your behalf. This raises significant privacy questions.
details: OpenAI has released an Apple Messages plug-in for ChatGPT, allowing users to integrate their Messages inbox directly with the chatbot. This feature enables ChatGPT to interact with your conversations.
The plug-in offers various functionalities, including sorting, analyzing, and editing messages. It also works with Codex and ChatGPT Work, extending its utility to professional contexts.
Users can instruct ChatGPT to suggest follow-up messages, delete old messages, draft and send new ones, or search for specific information within their message history.

OpenAI states the plug-in runs locally on the user's machine and does not create an index of all messages, aiming to address privacy concerns. However, the exact implications of this are not fully clear.
The company advises users to monitor ChatGPT's actions when sending messages and cautions against enabling persistent approval, as this removes the final review step before messages are sent.
caption:
ChatGPT can now draft, send, and even delete your Apple Messages! OpenAI just launched a new plug-in for seamless integration.

OpenAI has released an Apple Messages plug-in for ChatGPT, allowing users to integrate their Messages inbox directly with the chatbot. This feature enables ChatGPT to interact with your conversations.

The plug-in offers various functionalities, including sorting, analyzing, and editing messages. It also works with Codex and ChatGPT Work, extending its utility to professional contexts.

Users can instruct ChatGPT to suggest follow-up messages, delete old messages, draft and send new ones, or search for specific information within their message history.

OpenAI states the plug-in runs locally on the user's machine and does not create an index of all messages, aiming to address privacy concerns. However, the exact implications of this are not fully clear.

The company advises users to monitor ChatGPT's actions when sending messages and cautions against enabling persistent approval, as this removes the final review step before messages are sent.

headline: Apple reportedly lays off 60 Vision employees amid shifting priorities
summary: Apple has reportedly cut an entire team dedicated to VR development, impacting at least 60 employees. This move suggests a potential shift in the company's priorities for its Vision Pro headset.
details: Apple has reportedly laid off at least 60 employees from a team dedicated to virtual reality development. The cuts affect an entire unit focused on VR for the Vision Pro headset, according to sources.

These layoffs are said to be part of a broader reorganization and a shift in priorities within Apple's Vision division. The exact nature of these shifting priorities has not been officially disclosed by the company.
